Six Chapters, One Forever

Our Love Story

Some stories are not planned. They are simply written, long before two people ever meet.

Chapter One

An Unexpected Hello

It began quietly, through Malayali Shaadi matrimony. Two profiles, two families’ hopes, and one connection neither of us saw coming. What started as a simple introduction became the first line of our story.

I
Chapter Two

Messages & a Valentine’s Day

Conversations moved to Instagram, and soon we were talking every day. Long chats, shared laughter and slowly growing comfort led to our very first date on Valentine’s Day, a day that now feels like it was always meant to be ours.

II
Chapter Three

Surprises & Understanding

Birthday surprises, more meetings and a few disagreements too. Each one taught us to listen better, to forgive faster and to understand each other more deeply. We learned that love is not only the sweet moments, but the choosing of each other every day.

III
Chapter Four · 26 April 2026

Kerala & The Engagement

A vacation in Kerala, surrounded by home, family and blessings, turned into the most beautiful day yet. On 26 April 2026, we exchanged rings and promises, and our families became one.

IV
Chapter Five

Back to Dubai, Side by Side

Back in Dubai, life returned to busy jobs and full calendars. Through long days and tired evenings, we became each other’s strength, cheering one another on and making room for love in the middle of everything.

V
Chapter Six · 14 January 2027

Forever Begins

And now, the chapter we have been waiting for. On 14 January 2027, we will become husband and wife, surrounded by the people we love most. Your presence and blessings would make our day complete.

VI
